001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.log4j;
002
003import java.util.Map;
004
005import org.apache.logging.log4j.ThreadContext;
006import org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.Provider;
007
008import io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues;
009import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
010
011/**
012 * Registered via {@link java.util.ServiceLoader} ({@code META-INF/services/}
013 * {@link Provider org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.Provider}), not the older
014 * {@code META-INF/log4j-provider.properties} mechanism: decompiling this version of
015 * {@code log4j-api} shows that path's {@code Provider(Properties, URL, ClassLoader)}
016 * constructor unconditionally sets {@code versions} to <code>null</code>, which
017 * {@code ProviderUtil}/{@code validVersion} then rejects outright ("Ignoring provider for
018 * incompatible version"), confirmed empirically: a properties-file-registered provider is
019 * silently never selected. The subclass-plus-{@link java.util.ServiceLoader} path used
020 * here still populates {@link #getVersions()} correctly (from the
021 * {@link Provider#Provider(Integer, String, Class) Provider(Integer, String, Class)}
022 * constructor called below), so it is picked up correctly.
023 */
024@ServiceProvider(Provider.class)
025public final class RainbowGumLog4jProvider extends Provider {
026
027        /*
028         * Log4j creates its provider before ThreadContext can hold anything. Reading
029         * ThreadContext before then would make an unrelated logging API (JUL, ...) initialize
030         * Log4j as a side effect.
031         */
032        private static volatile boolean initialized;
033
034        /**
035         * For {@link java.util.ServiceLoader}.
036         */
037        @SuppressWarnings("StaticAssignmentInConstructor") // see initialized
038        public RainbowGumLog4jProvider() {
039                super(10, CURRENT_VERSION, RainbowGumLoggerContextFactory.class);
040                initialized = true;
041        }
042
043        /*
044         * Both the map (key values) and the stack (NDC).
045         */
046        static void clearThreadContext() {
047                if (initialized) {
048                        ThreadContext.clearAll();
049                }
050        }
051
052        static KeyValues currentThreadContextKeyValues() {
053                if (!initialized) {
054                        return KeyValues.of();
055                }
056                Map<String, String> context = ThreadContext.getImmutableContext();
057                return context.isEmpty() ? KeyValues.of() : KeyValues.of(context);
058        }
059
060}
